name: Elijah Stroud
want: hold on to the discovery claim and see the town built on terms he sets
secret: He sold a share in the gulch to a Fort Bridger trader last winter to buy flour, and the trader will come to collect.
voice: Few words, most of them doubtful.
description: A prospector who has been in every rush since California in '49 and has nothing to show for it but this gulch.
appearance: Bent, leathery, a patched miner's coat and a rifle he cleans while he talks.
